source.title: WCA South American Championship 2018 on December 15 - 16, 2018 in Poá, SP, Brazil
source.content: The [WCA South American Championship 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthAmericanChampionship2018) will take place on December 15 - 16, 2018 in Poá, SP, Brazil. Check out the [WCA South American Championship 2018 website](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthAmericanChampionship2018) for more information and registration.

translation.title: 2018 年 WCA 南美锦标赛将于 12 月 15–16 日在巴西圣保罗州波阿举行
translation.content: [2018 年 WCA 南美锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthAmericanChampionship2018)将于 2018 年 12 月 15–16 日在巴西圣保罗州波阿举行。更多信息及报名请见[2018 年 WCA 南美锦标赛网站](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthAmericanChampionship2018)。
